card.name: Units or 'of' after partial amounts
card.fires_on: The unit (mg, mcg) right after a dose-change amount, or 'of' right after a fraction or percent or 'remainder', followed by a dose or total.

modes.label: Unit after step amount
modes.description: The unit mg or mcg right after a number that says how much to raise, lower or taper a dose.
modes.example: Titrate dosage by 1 mg to 2<< mg>> twice daily, no more frequently than every

modes.label: 'of' after a share
modes.description: The word 'of' after a percent, fraction or 'remainder', before the dose or drug.
modes.example: approximately 20%<< of>> argatroban was cleared through dialysis
